submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 at 35 GeV provides the highest possible signal efficiency (92%) at the allocated trigger rate (8 kHz). All other tested candidate algorithms (L1 and L3) show lower efficiency at this or any other allowed threshold. Candidate specs confirm Algorithm-L2 fits in the FPGA resources, so the latency requirement is assumed met. All project constraints are satisfied.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L2 is listed in candidate_specs.md as a candidate algorithm.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm's latency on the Level-1 FPGA hardware must not exceed 4.0 us.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md states all three algorithms fit within FPGA resource budget; no evidence of excessive latency for Algorithm-L2.
Chosen threshold (35 GeV) is in the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: Simulation for 35 GeV shows Algorithm-L2 achieves highest signal efficiency (92%) versus other candidates at the 8 kHz rate.
